intent: A cloister of the Eternal Domain: a square of tall ivory arches round a walled garden court, rills and gold cypresses and a fountain of holy light at its heart, the processional road passing through the arcade; the game has no cloister, no enclosed garden court and no fountain.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: fountain framed by the arcade
critic.why: Clean, legible cloister with a good fountain; one layout repeated.

role: Crossing: cloister the processional road passes through.
notes:
# A

Keep: Keep the arcade-round-fountain read; it is the clearest garden court in the run.

1. Vary the plan across seeds: L-shaped or double courts, an off-centre fountain, a broken arcade side.
2. Put one tall figure or obelisk in the court so the arcade rhythm has a peak.
3. Run rills out from the fountain so the garden beds read from above, not only the ring.
